```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(pwr)          # power for t-tests
library(BayesFactor)  # Bayes Factors for t-tests
library(MASS)         # for rnegbin (overdispersed counts)


theme_criticism <- function() {
  require(ggplot2)
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica", size = 12),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", linewidth = 0.6),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "inside",
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
}

# The order of labels to use
venue_levels <- function() {
  c(
    "Nature",
    "Science",
    "PNAS",
    "PRL",
    "Other APS"
  )
}

collapse_aps <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(venue = as.character(venue)) %>%
    mutate(
      venue = ifelse(
        venue %in% c("PR-A", "PR-B", "PR-C", "PR-D", "PR-E"),
        "Other APS",
        venue
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(venue %in% venue_levels()) %>%
    mutate(venue = factor(venue, levels = venue_levels()))
}


power_analysis <- function(df) {
  
  venues <- c("Nature", "Science", "PNAS", "PRL", "Other APS")
  SESOI_diffs <- c(0.10, 0.2, 0.5, 0.80)

  all_results <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(venues, function(v) {
    # sort so that treatment and control vectors are aligned by matched pair
    for_venue <- df %>%
      filter(venue == v) %>%
      arrange(match.group, treat)
    
    control <- for_venue %>% filter(treat == 0) 
    treat <- for_venue %>% filter(treat == 1)
    
    diff = log(treat$growth) - log(control$growth)
    
    n1 <- length(diff)
    sd_diff_log <- sd(diff, na.rm = T)
    
    results <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(SESOI_diffs, function(x) {
      
      SESOI_log <- log(1 + x)
      
      # Cohen's d for that log-scale difference
      d_SESOI <- SESOI_log / sd_diff_log
  
      pwr_out <- pwr.t.test(
        d = d_SESOI,
        n = n1,
        sig.level = 0.05,
        type = "paired",
        alternative = "two.sided"
      )
      
      tab <- tidy(pwr_out)
      tab$d = d_SESOI
      tab$diff = x
      tab$venue = v
      tab$sesoi_log = SESOI_log
      tab$sd = sd_diff_log
      
      return(tab)
    }))
  
  return(results)
  }))
  
  return(all_results)
}
```

```{r bf_bic}

#frame <- fauthors_cite %>% filter(venue == "Nature")


bayes_factor_analysis <- function(frame) {
  venues <- c("Nature", "Science", "PNAS", "PRL", "Other APS")
  
  results <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(venues, function(v) {
    # sort so that treatment and control vectors are aligned by matched pair
    frame_filt <- frame %>% filter(venue == v) %>% arrange(match.group, treat)
    
    # --- Bayes Factor (two-sample t on log scale, default Cauchy prior) ---
    # these are the sample means
    control <- log(frame_filt$growth[frame_filt$treat == 0])
    treat <- log(frame_filt$growth[frame_filt$treat == 1])
    
    diff = treat - control
    
    bf_res <- ttestBF(x = diff) 
    BF10 <- extractBF(bf_res, onlybf = TRUE)    # evidence for H1 over H0
    BF01 <- 1 / BF10                            # evidence for H0 over H1
    
    return(data.frame(
      venue = v,
      BF01 = BF01
    ))
  }))
  
  return(results)
}

b_papers <- bayes_factor_analysis(papers) %>%
  mutate(population = "papers")


b_fauthors_cite <- bayes_factor_analysis(fauthors_cite) %>%
  mutate(population = "fauthors_cite")

b_fauthors_prod <- bayes_factor_analysis(fauthors_prod) %>%
  mutate(population = "fauthors_prod")


b_lauthors_cite <- bayes_factor_analysis(lauthors_cite) %>%
  mutate(population = "lauthors_cite")

b_lauthors_prod <- bayes_factor_analysis(lauthors_prod) %>%
  mutate(population = "lauthors_prod")


bfactors <- data.table::rbindlist(list(b_papers, b_fauthors_cite, b_lauthors_cite, b_fauthors_prod, b_lauthors_prod)) %>%
  mutate(
     population = factor(
      population,
      levels = c("papers", "fauthors_cite", "fauthors_prod", "lauthors_cite", "lauthors_prod"),
      labels = c("Papers", "First Authors\n(Cite)", "First Authors\n(prod)", "Last Authors\n(cite)", "Last Authors\n(prod)")
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    BF01 = round(BF01, 1)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = population, values_from = BF01)
```
